PROPOSED COMPLIANCE ORDER
Pursuant to 49 United States Code § 60118, the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
Administration (PHMSA) proposes to issue to Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc. a
Compliance Order incorporating the following remedial requirement to ensure the compliance of
Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, Inc. with the pipeline safety regulations:
A.

In regard to Item Number 2 of the Notice pertaining to Southern Star Central Gas
Pipeline (SSCGP)’s failure to follow proper procedures in an abnormal operation
condition when freeing a stuck In-Line Inspection (ILI) tool in their 10-inch diameter
Line FM natural gas transmission line, SSCGP must develop and incorporate into their
procedural manual for operations, maintenance and emergencies an appropriate
procedure for notification, documentation, and remedial actions when removing a stuck
internal device, i.e. an ILI tool within 90 days of receipt of the Final Order.

B.

It is requested that SSCGP maintain documentation of the safety improvement costs
associated with fulfilling this Compliance Order and submit the total to Gregory A. Ochs,
Director, Central Region, Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration. It is
requested that these costs be reported in two categories: 1) total cost associated with
preparation/revision of plans, procedures, studies and analyses, and 2) total cost
associated with replacements, additions and other changes to pipeline infrastructure.
